title: Prompt Result V1 (one stored prompt document, with its own identity)
$comment: This is the row src/design_lab/prompt_results.py writes: the prompt document plus the identity a reader needs to cite it later. `document` is the product's own prompt object and is bound by prompt-composition-v1 / prompt-reversal-v1 on the read side; it is NOT restated here, and the store refuses a document whose model.executed is not false, because nothing in this repository loads a model. `content_sha256` is the digest of `document` alone -- the response-side `persisted` block a route adds around it is deliberately outside the digest, so wrapping a document cannot change what it is.

allOf.$comment: The kind and the document version are one fact stated twice; a row that says COMPOSITION over a reversal document would let a reader branch on either and get two answers.
